schematic human head/upper body with broad shoulders

justification: Both surfaces present frontal, blocky, schematic anthropomorphic figures rendered in relief with faint incised markings across the surrounding field, which is the only real correspondence and is a very generic one. A shows a single massive figure dominating the field with an elaborate headdress, ornamented torso and a prominent central disc/pectoral, while B shows small paired figures set low within a large plain rock face with inscription-like traces above, so the specific attributes, scale relationships and compositional scheme differ entirely.
